Bob is red. Bob is young. Charlie is big. Charlie is green. Charlie is red. Charlie is rough. Charlie is young. Dave is big. Harry is rough. Harry is round. Harry is young. All rough, white things are young. All big things are round. All white, red things are rough. All round things are green. All big things are white. If Harry is round then Harry is big. All rough, young things are red. If something is young then it is green. All green things are red.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Dave is young.

Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?

Facts:
Red(Bob, True) ::: Bob is red.
Young(Bob, True) ::: Bob is young.
Big(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is big.
Green(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is green.
Red(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is red.
Rough(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is rough.
Young(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is young.
Big(Dave, True) ::: Dave is big.
Rough(Harry, True) ::: Harry is rough.
Round(Harry, True) ::: Harry is round.
Young(Harry, True) ::: Harry is young.

Rules:
Rough($x, True) && White($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: All rough, white things are young.
Big($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: All big things are round.
White($x, True) && Red($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: All white, red things are rough.
Round($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: All round things are green.
Big($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: All big things are white.
Round(Harry, True) >>> Big(Harry, True) ::: If Harry is round then Harry is big.
Rough($x, True) && Young($x, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: All rough, young things are red.
Young($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: If something is young then it is green.
Green($x, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: All green things are red.

Query:
Young(Dave, True) ::: Dave is young.
